content.short: DAOstack provides a complete package of tools to build, govern, and manage DAOs.
content.description: DAOstack, founded in 2017 by Metan Field and Adam Levi to advance the technology of collective, decentralized governance, is a complete package for building a DAO from the ground up—whether simple or sophisticated. It provides a full toolkit to construct and govern any kind of DAO, spanning frontend, backend, and middleware components. Beyond creation, DAOstack supports the day-to-day management and operation of DAOs, helping teams coordinate and govern their communities more effectively.
content.meta: DAOstack is a library of governance protocols and interfaces for scalable DAOs. Discover DAOstack and other DAO Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
